subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Archaeologists found burned stones and animal bones in a cave.”?
options: Students laughed because people long ago had also written on walls.
People long ago were not only builders of temples or fighters in wars.
They believed people had used fire there long ago.
Students were amazed that people so long ago made music.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Students laughed because people long ago had also written on walls.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「People long ago were not only builders of temples or fighters in wars.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「They believed people had used fire there long ago.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Students were amazed that people so long ago made music.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
